title: WHY AM I NOT A MILLIONAIRE YET?
author: Capitan00
selftext:
I made a game using Codex for coding and ChatGPT for generating the game assets.

I logged into ChatGPT in the browser and let Codex use it to generate assets (I know, I'm lazy 😂). My part was coming up with ideas for what the platforms should look like and how they should work.

Turns out AI can help you make an entire game, but apparently it doesn't automatically make you rich. Very disappointing. 😂

And I said **can help**, not that it will make the entire game from a **single prompt**, cuz apparently some sites don't allow AI content. Like you just write a 247-token prompt, go for a walk or grab a coffee, and boom, your game is ready.

Sooo, where are my **millions**? 🐸💰

replies.body: Yes those flappy bird type outliers are lucky
